definition: E = max(A, D), in stops, measured by LWPanoramaSeamMetric on the stitched picture. A is the mean, over covered pixels within 8 pixels of a seam, of the largest |log2(Y_out + e) - log2(Y_k + e)| over the frames k that see the pixel. D is the mean, over neighbouring pixel pairs that a seam separates, of max(0, |log2(Y_out(p) + e) - log2(Y_out(q) + e)| - the smaller of the same step in the two frames that meet there). Y is Rec. 709 luminance of linear values; Y_k is frame k resampled by the panorama's own alignment with its solved exposure and lens falloff removed; e = 1e-4. See docs/PANORAMA_MERGE.md, "Seam metric".
